Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Processo de Seleção

A ENEL valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas formas. Esta vaga é aberta para talentos de todas as idades, origens étnicas, gêneros, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero e pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Nosso processo de seleção inclui entrevista com recrutadores e reunião com o gestor para avaliação técnica. Se estiver alinhado ao cargo, entraremos em contato com informações adicionais.

Buscamos pessoas que incorporem nossos valores: Confiança, Respeito, Inovação, Proatividade e Flexibilidade.

Atualmente estamos com operações em sete parques, entre eles, os parques naturais, de vida animal e temáticos - Cataratas do Iguaçu, EcoNoronha, Paineiras-Corcovado, AquaRio, Marco das Três Fronteiras, BioParque do Rio e Jericoacoara, que impactam mais de 5,5 milhões de visitantes por ano. O próximo passo é a abertura do AquaFoz, que tem previsão de inauguração em 2025.
O Grupo Cataratas, através de seus atrativos, busca criar e promover um legado duradouro de impacto positivo. Somos feitos de gente para gente. Cuidamos do bem-estar dos nossos embaixadores para poder ressignificar a relação das pessoas com a natureza por meio de experiências verdadeiramente transformadoras, proporcionando visitações que divertem e conscientizam ao mesmo tempo.
Afinal, assim como a natureza, estamos em constante evolução. Atuamos através dos pilares de Educação, Pesquisa, Conservação e Entretenimento tendo a Sustentabilidade, Diversidade e Inovação como parte do nosso DNA.
Se identificou com os nossos valores? Venha fazer parte da maior empresa de Turismo Sustentável do Brasil!

Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?
Estamos buscando um Auxiliar de Almoxarifado/estoque, que será responsável por cumprir as rotinas de manutenção de materiais e insumos, como recebimento, organização e distribuição, de modo que atenda aos pré-requisitos das normas e procedimentos de segurança e qualidade.

Dia a Dia:

Conferência: Verificar se a quantidade e o tipo de produto recebido correspondem à nota fiscal e ao pedido de compra.
Inspeção: Verificar se os produtos estão em boas condições, sem danos ou defeitos.
Registro: Registrar a entrada dos produtos no sistema de controle de estoque.
Organização: Armazenar os produtos de forma organizada, seguindo as normas de segurança e otimizando o espaço disponível.
Identificação: Etiquetar os produtos com informações como código, descrição, lote e data de validade.
Conservação: Manter o estoque limpo e organizado, garantindo a conservação dos produtos.
Localização: Localizar os produtos solicitados nos pedidos de venda ou transferência.
Separação: Separar os produtos com cuidado, evitando erros e danos.
Embalagem: Embalar os produtos de forma adequada para o transporte.
Inventário: Realizar contagens periódicas do estoque para verificar a quantidade de produtos em cada local.

Local de atuação: Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário: 7h as 17h de segunda a quinta-feira | 7h as 16h na sexta-feira.

description:

13 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Support Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex Cloud environment issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. We are rapidly expanding and are looking for talented problem solvers with a passion for working on the next generation of Ubuntu solutions for our customers.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
  • Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.
  • Ownership of results: Ensure that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
  • Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
  • Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.
What are we looking for in you
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Hands-on and extensive working experience in supporting Linux systems including 3 or more of:
    • Virtualization / Cloud - primarily using KVM or OpenStack.
    • Containers - especially with Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.
    • Storage technologies - block, object and network.
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.).
  • Cloud computing expertise in provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.
  • Advanced troubleshooting experience:
    • Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
    • Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
    • Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to escalate to the correct team.
  • Programming fundamentals in any language.
  • Extensive Customer support experience is key:
    • Customer needs are top priority.
    • Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Analista de Digital Analytics (Temporária)

Avolta é líder mundial em experiência de viagens. Com uma filosofia centrada no viajante e uma rede geograficamente diversificada, no varejo de viagem e (A&B) alimentos e bebidas.

A empresa atende às necessidades de até 2,3 bilhões de passageiros a cada ano, com 5.500 pontos de venda em mais de 75 países em 06 continentes.

Guiados pela estratégia “Destination 2027” e impulsionada por sua recente combinação com a gigante de alimentos e bebidas Autogrill, a empresa está bem posicionada para concretizar sua ambição para criar uma revolução na experiência de viagem através de suas diversas localizações em aeroportos, rodovias, linhas de cruzeiro, portos marítimos e estações ferroviárias, entre outros.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados e Cientista de Dados para atuar na criação e gestão de dados voltados para o digital da empresa. Esse profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções analíticas, estruturar dados para geração de insights estratégicos e criar simulações para apoiar a tomada de decisão.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados para integrar diferentes fontes de informação;
  • Criar dashboards interativos e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI para monitoramento de KPIs;
  • Estruturar bases de dados eficientes para suportar análises de comportamento digital;
  • Realizar simulações e modelagens estatísticas para prever tendências e apoiar decisões estratégicas;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de marketing digital, tecnologia e negócios para entender as necessidades e oportunidades relacionadas a dados;
  • Garantir a qualidade, governança e segurança dos dados manipulados.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL e bancos de dados (SQL, NoSQL, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.);
  • Domínio de linguagens como Python, R ou Scala para análise e modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência em construção de dashboards e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Web Analytics e tracking digital (Google Analytics, Tag Manager, etc.);
  • Desejável experiência com engenharia de dados e/ou ciência de dados aplicada ao digital;
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados complexos em insights acionáveis para o negócio;
  • Inglês - avançado.

*Aceitamos também perfis PCD's.

Regime de trabalho: 04 dias da semana no escritório localizado no Centro / RJ e 01 dia da semana em Home Office. Podendo ser alterado, de acordo com a necessidade da empresa.

title: Analyst - Fund Administration (Treasury Services)
description:
This role is based in our office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. As an Analyst, you will report to the Associate Director.

The Analyst supports the Associate Director in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations within the treasury department. This includes working closely with internal teams, clients, and third-party stakeholders to ensure the timely and accurate execution of treasury functions such as payment processing, bank reconciliations, and client service. The role requires a highly organized individual with a strong understanding of banking systems, wire transfers, and operational policies. The Associate will be expected to adhere to operational procedures, manage payment processing, and assist with onboarding and offboarding clients.

From a high-level perspective, the core responsibilities that form your role are broken down into the following 7 categories:


  1. Treasury Service Operations

  2. Bank Platform & Access Management

  3. Operational Support & Team Collaboration

  4. Client Communication & SLA Management

  5. Reconciliation & Payment Verification

  6. Process Improvement & Feedback

  7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

Your Daily Tasks

The following are the tasks linked to the Core Responsibilities that will be expected as part of this role:


1. Treasury Service Operations:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Adherence to Policies & Procedures: Ensure compliance with Catalyst’s internal policies, procedures, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to treasury services. Support the Treasury Manager in maintaining and improving the operational framework for treasury functions.


b) Client Onboarding & Offboarding: Work with the Treasury Manager to onboard and offload clients, ensuring the appropriate banking platforms, counterparties, and payment systems are selected and properly utilized according to client requirements and regulatory standards.


c) Payment Processing: Oversee and process wire transfers, EFT-ACH payments, cheques, and other financial transactions across multiple international banking platforms. Ensure that payments are executed correctly, on time, and in compliance with agreed SLAs.


d) Escalation & Issue Resolution: Act as an escalation point for any issues or deviations in the payment process, ensuring that problems are identified and resolved quickly. Communicate deviations to the Treasury Manager and senior stakeholders as needed.


2. Bank Platform & Access Management:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Access Management: Work with the Treasury Manager to ensure that all Treasury team members have appropriate access to banking platforms and financial systems. Act as the backup for managing and monitoring staff access rights, ensuring compliance with security protocols and policies.


b) Bank System Monitoring: Regularly monitor the bank systems for any service requests, system errors, or other discrepancies. Inform the Treasury Manager and relevant regional office staff if action is needed to address issues or escalate requests.


c) Callbacks & Payment Verifications: Ensure the team follows callback procedures when necessary to verify payment details. Ensure callbacks are completed in a timely manner, in line with Catalyst’s internal controls, to avoid errors and fraud.


3. Operational Support & Team Collaboration:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Workflow Management: Support the day-to-day workflow of the treasury function, ensuring that all tasks are completed on time and in accordance with SLAs. Assist with payment batch preparation and the reconciliation of prior day’s transactions.


b) Documentation & Record-Keeping: Ensure that all necessary documentation related to payments, wires, and transactions is collected and stored appropriately in centralized systems in line with Catalyst’s record-keeping policies.


c) Training & Guidance: Work with the Treasury Manager to support the team by providing guidance and assisting with any improvements or process updates. Train junior team members on treasury operations, best practices, and internal procedures.


d) Payment Information Accuracy: Ensure that critical payment details, such as beneficiary bank information and invoice approvals, are accurate and up-to-date. Follow up to resolve discrepancies and ensure proper completion of payments.


4. Client Communication & SLA Management:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Client Service Support: Provide essential support to the Investor Services team and clients by assisting with all payment requests and inquiries. Ensure communication with clients and internal teams is clear, effective, and prompt.


b) SLA Adherence: Help monitor and ensure that Treasury services meet client-specific SLAs. Work with the Treasury Manager to manage key performance indicators (KPIs) related to payment processing and other treasury functions. Take proactive steps to address any issues or delays that might impact service levels.


5. Reconciliation & Payment Verification:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Daily Reconciliation: Assist in the reconciliation of daily payments to ensure that all wire transfers are successfully processed and that no payments are returned or rejected. Identify discrepancies and ensure any issues are resolved in a timely manner.


b) Payment Batch Preparation: Prepare payment batches for various payment methods, including international wire payments, EFT-ACH transactions, and cheques. Ensure all substantiating documentation is collected and maintained.


b) Follow-up on Payments: Review payments to ensure that the key information (e.g., bank details, invoice amounts) has not changed between approval and payment. Follow up with clients and counterparties as necessary to resolve any issues before payment is processed.


6. Process Improvement & Feedback:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Feedback & Process Improvement: Provide proactive feedback to the Treasury Manager and senior management on potential improvements in the treasury services processes. Identify areas for optimization and assist with implementing changes to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction.


b) Policy & Procedure Updates: Contribute to the ongoing review and improvement of policies and procedures related to treasury services, ensuring they remain relevant and effective. Assist in implementing any necessary changes to align with best practices, regulatory updates, and client requirements.


7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:


a) Comply with relevant regulatory frameworks, including anti-money laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and FATCA/CRS reporting requirements. Work with the Compliance team to ensure that treasury-related regulatory filings are timely and accurate.


b) Compliance Tasks: Perform routine compliance checks and adhere to company risk and compliance processes and policies.


c)Record Keeping: Maintain organized records of compliance documents and reports.


d) Documentation Support: Assist in maintaining compliance documentation and records.


e) Monitoring Tasks: Help monitor compliance tasks and assist with quality control processes.


f) Compliance Culture - Working in tandem with the compliance colleagues to support a culture that is centered around good governance and compliance.

Additional Strategic Expectations

  • Share insights to enable development of new processes and procedures that will create business efficiency and support delivery of client excellence in service.
  • Maintain awareness of industry, regulatory, jurisdictional, and other trends that could affect the business.
  • Contribute to the creation, development and implementation of new products and solutions to accommodate the businesses continuous changing needs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations staff, business users, project, and implementation managers to achieve desired and elegant solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Are you getting excited? We are! Before we get too carried away, there are a few requirements you’ll need to check off before you can apply for the position:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 1 year of professional experience in the Fund Administration industry, with specific experience in Treasury or Investor Services.
  • Knowledge of international banking systems and wire transfer procedures. Must have experience working with payment systems and handling financial transactions in a corporate environment.
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken). Proficiency in Portuguese is highly desirable, especially when working with Brazilian clients.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing payment details, transaction reconciliations, and financial records.
  • Effective organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Ability to handle high volumes of transactions while maintaining accuracy.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with both internal and external stakeholders clearly and professionally.

Senior Channel Relationship Manager, Amazon Logistica

Do you want to work hard, have fun and make history? If you do, then Amazon could be the right career choice for you. Our logistics team are changing the way we interact with customers around the globe every single day and solving some of the biggest logistical challenges facing not just Amazon, but also the entire industry. The role requires someone who has a larger picture of customer experience in mind and high willingness to take ownership. The role also requires a candidate who has skills in identifying patterns along with ability to scrutinize details and suggest solutions to deviations.

- Dive Deep on operational issues root causes;
- Create and track operational metrics
- Willing to work during weekends/holidays

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Employee and performance management experience
- Previous experience in last mile transportation/account management
- MS Office experience required, with advanced level in Excel
- Fluent English, both oral and written

Join to apply for the Shopify Full Stack Developer role at Darkroom

About Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

About Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
We’re hiring a Full-Stack Shopify Developer to support the design, development, and optimization of high-performing e-commerce sites. This role requires deep technical experience across front- and back-end Shopify development, with strong attention to performance, scalability, and detail.
You’ll collaborate with design, marketing, and strategy teams to build, maintain, and improve custom storefronts that align with business goals. The ideal candidate is hands-on, solution-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple projects in a fast-moving environment.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Spain, Brazil, and Mexico.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop custom Shopify themes and functionalities from scratch, ensuring responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and optimal site performance.
  • Implement third-party Shopify apps and integrations to enhance store functionality.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, adhering to best practices.
  • Collaborate with design and marketing teams to translate UI/UX designs into engaging and responsive websites.
  • Maintain, debug, and improve existing Shopify sites, identifying areas for optimization.
  • Manage backend tasks such as product catalog updates, customer data integrations, payment gateway setups, and other custom integrations.
  • Optimize sites for speed, scalability, SEO, and conversions.
  • Conduct comprehensive QA and testing processes before deployment.
  • Stay updated on emerging Shopify trends, tools, and technologies, and proactively suggest improvements.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing Shopify websites.
  • Proficiency in Liquid templating language, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  • Experience with Shopify API integrations and custom app development.
  • Knowledge of Tailwind CSS for rapid UI development.
  • Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and familiarity with modern development workflows.
  • Strong understanding of website optimization techniques, SEO best practices, and analytics.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Familiarity with Shopify Plus and headless commerce architectures.
  • Experience with GraphQL.
  • Experience with relevant frameworks (React, Vue.js, or similar).
  • Previous experience in an agency or fast-paced e-commerce environment.
What It's Like To Work At Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

Unidas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Description

Job Description
A Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil. Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país. Conta também com mais de 200 lojas entre aluguel de carros e venda de seminovos, incluindo leves e pesados, no varejo e atacado. A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work. Além disso, foi eleita como a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”. Empoderamos as pessoas do nosso time e investimos no aprendizado diário e desenvolvimento contínuo. Aqui, cada Unilover é responsável por sua carreira e a leva para onde quiser. Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser? #VemPraUnidas
Responsibilities and assignments
Buscamos uma pessoas que tenha paixão pela área Comercial;
Que se sinta confortável em trabalhar com metas e possua dinamismo e boa comunicação.
O que você vai fazer?

  • Realizar a venda de veículos seminovos, identificando a necessidade do cliente, orientando-o com informações referente aos veículos e financiamento.
  • Prospectar clientes através de anúncios.
  • Acompanhar em test-drive, quando necessário.
Requirements And Qualifications
Para ser Consultor(a) de vendas é importante:
  • Ter vontade de vender e ser motivado por novos desafios.
  • Experiência na área comercial, preferencialmente em varejo.
  • Habilidade no encantamento de clientes.
  • Ter empatia para inspirar a confiança dos clientes, atingindo o resultado desejado com otimismo e persistência.
  • Habilidade de atuar com metas e orientação para resultados.
  • Ter CNH B - ativa;
  • Ensino médio - completo.
Additional information
Você Vai Encontrar Na Unidas Um Ambiente Dinâmico, Inovador e Cheio De Oportunidades. Colocamos o Cliente No Centro Das Nossas Decisões, Temos Uma Visão Focada Nos Resultados, Apostamos No Desenvolvimento Do Nosso Time e Agimos Com Respeito à Sociedade e Às Pessoas. O Nosso Pacote De Benefícios Contempla
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Gympass;
  • Programa de Lucros e Resultados;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte.
Seja bem-vindo(a)!
Na Unidas, acreditamos que carreira é jornada , não destino . Somos um dos maiores grupos do Brasil no setor de mobilidade e terceirização de frotas , com soluções completas que vão de veículos leves a pesados, passando por máquinas e equipamentos. Mas o que realmente nos move são as pessoas .
Somos um time que se movimenta em um único sentido: simplificar a vida dos nossos clientes com soluções completas, inovação em aluguel de ativos e serviços confiáveis . Esse é o nosso destino — e a nossa cultura é o veículo que nos leva até lá.
Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo , o aprendizado diário e o empoderamento individual . Acreditamos que cada talento tem o poder de transformar realidades — e oferecemos as ferramentas, o ambiente e os desafios certos para isso acontecer.
Com Mais De 50 Anos De História, Presença Em Todo o Brasil e Mais De 120 Mil Ativos Em Operação, a Unidas é Feita De Movimento, Crescimento e Transformação. Atuamos Com Excelência Em Diversas Frentes
  • Unidas Aluguel de Carros: mobilidade sob medida para pessoas e empresas.
  • Unidas Livre: assinatura de veículos 0km com praticidade e liberdade.
  • Unidas Frotas: gestão inteligente de frotas leves e pesadas.
  • Unidas Pesados: soluções robustas para os setores agrícola, de mineração e construção.
  • Unidas Seminovos: veículos com procedência e ótimo custo-benefício.
POR QUE ESCOLHER A UNIDAS PARA SUA CARREIRA?
E tem mais! Na Unidas você ainda conta com:
  • Cultura de protagonismo e colaboração.
  • Programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação.
  • Ambiente que valoriza a diversidade e inclusão.
  • Desafios reais com impacto direto nos negócios.
  • Oportunidades em diferentes regiões e áreas de atuação.
FAZEMOS PARTE DE ALGO MAIOR.
A Unidas integra o portfólio da Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.
Deu match com o nosso jeito de ser e busca um lugar onde possa crescer, aprender, inovar e fazer parte de uma história de transformação, a Unidas é o seu caminho certo .
Aqui, sua carreira tem direção, propósito e movimento.

Realizar contatos via ligações telefônicas, e-mails ou visitas presenciais para apresentar os produtos;

A Non-Custodial Wallet Designed for Everyday Users
Our wallet is built with a core focus on asset protection, ensuring that users' crypto remains safe and accessible, even in the event of unforeseen circumstances.
Tailored specifically for retail users who are new to the crypto space, especially those transitioning from centralized exchanges, our wallet offers a seamless, intuitive experience that feels as familiar as online banking.
What truly sets us apart is our unparalleled access to the largest distribution of crypto newcomers. This gives us a unique advantage: any product we build is instantly positioned in front of a high-intent audience ready to adopt it.
Our Vision

Now, we are embarking on an exciting new venture to build a comprehensive crypto estate planning and non-custodial wallet.
We are launching this new product after witnessing substantial success in the DeFi education space and identifying a significant demand directly from our customers. Our unfair advantage over any competition is our distribution: we own a growing army of loyal customers eager to purchase our new solutions.

This is more than a job; it's a call to those who are in it for the long term. This crypto estate planning and non-custodial wallet will completely redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond. description:

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems

2 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical
As a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.
You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs region.
The role entails

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects
What we are looking for in you
  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
COORDENADOR DE GESTÃO DE ATIVOS DA FROTA / Fleet Asset Management Coordinator

Responsável por coordenar a gestão da manutenção, confiabilidade e integridade dos equipamentos e sistemas da embarcação, assegurando o controle e a atualização contínua dos custos, o monitoramento e redução do backlog. Atua como ponto focal técnico em reuniões estratégicas, especialmente com a SPC, fornecendo informações técnicas precisas para a tomada de decisão e para o atendimento das obrigações contratuais. Contribui para o mapeamento do perfil de risco da unidade, considerando as limitações de recursos (POB), e apoia a priorização e execução das atividades, promovendo a segurança, a eficiência operacional e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos do negócio.

Buscamos profissional para posição de Coordenação de Gestão de Ativos da Frota . O local de atuação é flexível, podendo ser Rio Corporate Office, Macaé ou Santos, dependendo da necessidade da área e alinhamento ao longo do processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades principais:

  1. Garantir a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos e sistemas , reportando ao Gerente de Ativo e Operações quaisquer vulnerabilidades identificadas pelas equipes offshore ou pelos departamentos de suporte onshore.
  2. Gerenciar e monitorar o backlog de manutenção dos principais equipamentos da unidade , assegurando a eficiência e disponibilidade dos ativos, bem como a conformidade com requisitos de projeto, operação e manutenção, identificando e implementando oportunidades de redução do backlog e melhorias nos processos.
  3. Atuar como canal de comunicação entre as demandas do cliente e a gestão de ativos , priorizando e encaminhando essas demandas para as áreas responsáveis, garantindo o devido tratamento.
  4. Ser o ponto focal técnico da embarcação em assuntos relacionados às SPCs , fornecendo informações técnicas para a emissão de comunicados sobre falhas ou interrupções que impactem obrigações contratuais, resultando em shutdown ou downtime.
  5. Apoiar o planejamento orçamentário anual de despesas e investimentos do ativo , fornecendo informações baseadas em experiências anteriores, histórico de manutenção, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas de mercado, além de mapear riscos para subsidiar decisões gerenciais.
  6. Fornecer informações técnicas precisas e atualizadas para subsidiar a emissão e aprovação de NAMs , monitorando relatórios de fechamento, acompanhando a execução de reparos e projetos de engenharia, além de orientar a equipe no desenvolvimento e análise de KPIs e estatísticas relevantes.
  7. Assegurar o alinhamento técnico com o Gerente de Ativo e Operações, clientes, parceiros e investidores , participando ativamente das reuniões técnicas mensais com a SPC, apresentando resultados baseados em informações atualizadas e fundamentadas, e atuando como ponto focal para esclarecimentos técnicos durante essas reuniões.
  8. Contribuir para o desenvolvimento, controle e validação de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais padronizados em nível de frota , assegurando a qualidade e a consistência das informações relacionadas à confiabilidade e integridade dos ativos.
  9. Apoiar o crescimento do negócio e a melhoria contínua dos processos , participando e colaborando na implementação de projetos estratégicos e corporativos.
  10. Contribuir para a elaboração de planos de shutdown eficazes , validando o escopo em conjunto com a equipe de turnaround, considerando aspectos de confiabilidade, conformidade legal, integridade e segurança de processos.
  11. Manter comunicação constante com os times TIER 2T, 2R e 3 , identificando rapidamente problemas e gargalos nos ativos para evitar paradas não programadas, além de garantir a execução oportuna de recomendações técnicas e reparos a bordo.
  12. Atuar de forma integrada com o TIER 4, com foco no controle e na atualização contínua dos custos , garantindo que todas as despesas estejam alinhadas ao orçamento anual corporativo e que os custos relacionados aos centros de custo de NAMs, EI e Operações sejam monitorados e atualizados de forma eficiente e tempestiva.
  13. Participar ativamente da rotina da Célula de Operações , incluindo reuniões diárias, planejamento integrado e acompanhamento de atividades, promovendo uma cultura de trabalho em equipe, desenvolvimento e equilíbrio na distribuição de tarefas.
  14. Apoiar o Gerente de Ativo e Operações na interface com o cliente , participando de reuniões, respondendo a demandas, elaborando comunicações formais e auxiliando em negociações contratuais, conforme orientação.
  15. Auxiliar o Gerente de Ativo e Operações em questões de gestão de equipe , especialmente nas áreas de Engenharia de Manutenção e Planejamento, resolução de conflitos, treinamentos e cobertura de ausências, quando necessário.
  16. Gerenciar o inventário onshore e offshore , buscando acurácia, aderência às diretrizes da companhia e oportunidades de otimização e ganhos financeiros.
  17. Trabalhar em equipe com os demais Tiers no mapeamento do perfil de risco da unidade , considerando as atividades possíveis de serem realizadas com os recursos limitados pelo POB (Personnel On Board) da unidade, auxiliando na tomada de decisão quanto à necessidade de alocação de recursos adicionais de POB para garantir a execução segura e eficiente das operações.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação Superior Completa em Engenharia;
  • CREA obrigatório;
  • Sólido conhecimento em engenharia de FPSO/FSO, operações e experiência com liderança;
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório);
  • Desejável experiência em Gestão de Projetos;

Fazer parte da MODEC é ser protagonista de uma carreira repleta de desafios, atuando com os sistemas mais modernos de produção em águas profundas, com oportunidades de crescimento global.

Se você é dinâmico, comprometido , com espírito inovador e deseja trabalhar em uma multinacional referência na indústria de óleo e gás, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe.

description:
Golang System Software Engineer - Containers / Virtualisation

Golang System Software Engineer - Containers / Virtualisation

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
The mission of the LXD team is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We are hiring a Golang software engineer to work on the low level Go codebase sitting between our REST API and the low level C libraries used to manage containers and virtual machines. We are looking for system-level developers with experience in design and data management/modeling.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
What you will focus on

  • Design, implement and document system level Go code
  • Model data, design database schema and implement data storage in a dqlite (SQL) database
  • Maintain code quality through static analysis, unit and system tests
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks/year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You have experience programming in Go and C
  • You are knowledgeable in networking and storage technologies
  • You have experience with two or more of: cloud computing, virtualisation, containers, distributed systems, open source community
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are enterprising, thoughtful and self-motivated
  • You have a bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Field Service Electrical Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Field Service Electrical Engineer role at Baker Hughes

14 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Field Service Electrical Engineer role at Baker Hughes

Would you like to work in the field supporting our customers?
Are you a Field Service Electrical Engineer looking for an interesting opportunity?
Do you enjoy working independently with a high level of accountability?
Our Turbomachinery & Process Solutions team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team ensures the integrity of data and provides valuable financial insight to the business.
Partner with the best
As a Field Service Electrical Engineer, you will play a vital role in creating products that fulfil both business and technical needs of our customers. You'll oversee the installation/commissioning/startup and various level maintenance/trouble-shooting of our products. You'll use your knowledge and skills to deliver innovative solutions for our customers.
As a Field Service Electrical Engineer , you will be responsible for:

  • Commission HV Generators, Motors, Synchronous condensers, Power management systems (PMS), Electrical protection systems, Excitation Controllers (AVRs), and Synchronising equipment.
  • Ideally have knowledge of networking systems. Such as, Modbus, Ethernet, 61850, Fibre.
  • Perform role applying company health and safety procedures applicable to the job site. Typical examples are HV safety, lock out tag out, permit to work systems and risk and method statements.
  • Conduct upgrades to AVRS, PMS systems, Synchronisers, Protection relays and other control elements.
  • Carry out electrical testing on high and low voltage equipment and machine windings in the field. Examples may include Polarisation Index, Insulation resistance, and Ductor tests.
  • Must be prepared to practice some degree of project management at site.
  • Deliver training on Brush Power Gen products to clients and field service colleagues.
  • Interpret technical drawings, specifications and technical requirements. Attend technical meetings on site and at customers’ premises.
  • Prepare method statements and risk assessments in relation to client sites where needed.
  • Assist mechanical service engineer(s) on assignments, which will not necessarily involve electrical related activities.
  • The job description is not to be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive and you may be required to undertake various duties as may reasonably be required of you by the Company.

Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:

  • Ideally hold a graduate degree or bachelors degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering.
  • Alternatively completed a recognised craft apprenticeship in electrical engineering and be able to demonstrate significant experience gained working in the field. Must hold a technical qualification in an electrical or electronic discipline.
  • Experience of working on competitors equipment would be advantageous.
  • High level knowledge of electrical power generation and distribution systems.
  • Self reliant, resourceful and a problem solver with well developed commercial awareness
  • An effective communicator, fluent in both spoken and written English and Portuguese.
  • Able to undertake extensive overseas and offshore working.
  • Experienced in representing the Company at customers’ sites and operating remotely on own initiative whilst observing the requirements set down in the Company’s Code of Conduct for Service/Commissioning Engineers.
  • Able to work with Company’s rules and guidance notes on health and safety, including operation of safe systems of work in relation to high voltage and medium voltage electrical systems and work in a heavy industrial environment.
  • This is a challenging and important role requiring a high degree of technical competence with a corresponding level of self-sufficiency and resourcefulness, as global time differences often mean that factory support is not immediately available. The nature of the work calls for strength of character and physical fitness. Differing assignments may require working alone or as a member of a team.
  • Clear understanding of cultural differences and has the diplomacy to cope with all aspects of the role.

Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Join as an early engineer and build products to prevent financial crime.
Sandbar
Sandbar's mission is to improve the health of the global financial system by fighting money laundering and other financial crimes.
By law, financial institutions must monitor transactions for illicit activity. However, most institutions find it difficult to do so effectively. Roughly $6T is laundered every year and $180B is spent on anti-money-laundering efforts by US institutions. Despite this, less than 1% of laundered money is identified correctly. We are also seeing many systems produce false-positive rates of over 95%. Consequently, banks and the government must spend extra time and resources on extraneous investigations, taking away resources from finding criminals.
Product
To achieve our goal, we ingest and standardize millions of messy data points coming from financial institutions that may sign up for the service. Once we have standardized and ingested the data, we can run complex calculations on it, checking for suspicious behavior and building a score around the riskiness of a given profile. If anything is found, we can surface that to our clients. By providing information accessibility, building intuitive workflows, allowing for custom processing, and curating accurate data, we can reduce the false-positive rate of our calculations, and reduce the amount of work dedicated to a given investigation.
You
We are looking for engineers who are excited about building a company from the ground up. As a founding engineer at Sandbar, you'll be responsible for defining and building features in our product to enable our customers to model and detect suspicious activity on their platforms. You'll work cross-functionally, collaborating with members of the team who have expertise in the subject matter, product management, design, infrastructure and security, to solve real-world problems our customers face. You'll have a lot of autonomy and freedom. You will learn and touch almost every part of the stack; big bonus if you're comfortable being a "Swiss Army knife". As we grow, you will be able to determine your own path and build skills you want to develop by directing your career growth and specialization. You're excited by and personally interested in how AI is reshaping they way we build products and solve problems; and you want to use it for positive far-reaching, real-world impact.
Team
We’re a small, but mighty and collaborative team based in NYC focused on delivering world-class software for our clients. You will not be in NYC, but you will visit NYC every now and then. And multiple people from our NYC office will visit you more often; in-person collaboration is priceless in the early days of building an enduring business so we will do our best to continue that value with our Central and South American teammates. We've raised from some amazing investors and have a group of amazing advisors and partners who can help us build the right things. This includes 3 institutional VC funds––Lachy Groom, Abstract Ventures, and BoxGroup––and 45+ angel investors including founders, executives, and early employees of Ramp, Stripe, Plaid, Remitly, Revolut, Google, Open AI, Square, and more.
What You'll Do

  • Work with a broad range of technologies and systems to own and solve problems end-to-end.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, and product managers to build new features in our product and data platform.
  • Contribute to our technical vision and uphold our high engineering standards.
  • Leverage new technologies like AI to continuously uplevel the quality and speed of delivery.
What You'll Need
  • 5 years of relevant work experience.
  • Great communication skills, and a high degree of awareness and agency.
  • Track record of delivering high-quality products and features end-to-end.
  • Ability to turn real-world problems and opportunities into engineering solutions.
  • Desire to work in a highly collaborative environment, and to continuously grow and master your craft.
  • Experience or willingness to heavily leverage new technologies like AI in your code and the product itself.
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Pulumi, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of SQL and experience with Postgres.
  • Experience with Flink, Iceberg, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in a large Java codebase.
  • Experience with Python, a growing part of our codebase.
  • Experience with Typescript, Next.js, React, and MUI.
  • Experience using AI-based development tools like Cursor, etc.
Benefits

  • Commuter benefits.
  • Access to an office if you want to go in.
  • Free lunches everyday.
Sandbar celebrates diversity and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. Additionally, we value potential and growth, so even if you don’t feel that you fulfill all of the criteria, you should still feel comfortable applying, and your application will be considered fairly.

O Copacabana Palace está contratando para o cargo de Bartender, que será responsável por auxiliar na preparação e serviço de drinks e bebidas, produção de ingredientes e organização do bar, garantindo a satisfação e superação das expectativas dos hóspedes, proporcionando uma experiência única, memorável e vivenciando os valores da Belmond em todas as suas atitudes.

  • Polir os materiais a serem utilizados.
  • Servir as bebidas em eventos.
  • Manter o bar e a copa do bar em ordem.

  • Apoiar os setores de A&B, quando necessário.

  • Conhecimento em técnicas de serviços no restaurante.

  • Folga de Aniversário

O Mecânico de Refrigeração é responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, como ar-condicionado, câmaras frigoríficas, freezers e outros equipamentos similares. Este profissional assegura o funcionamento eficiente e seguro dos sistemas de refrigeração, realizando diagnósticos, trocas de componentes e ajustes técnicos necessários para manter os ambientes adequadamente refrigerados. Principais Responsabilidades:Realizar a instalação de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado em ambientes comerciais, industriais e residenciais, seguindo as normas técnicas e de segurança. Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos de refrigeração, identificando problemas, realizando ajustes, substituição de peças e limpeza de componentes para garantir o desempenho ideal. Realizar reparos em compressores, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansão e demais componentes dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo a restauração completa do equipamento. Realizar a carga e recarga de gás refrigerante nos sistemas, conforme as especificações técnicas e normas ambientais. Testar e ajustar os equipamentos após a instalação ou reparo, verificando a temperatura, pressão, fluxo de ar e outros parâmetros para assegurar o funcionamento correto. Preencher relatórios de serviços realizados, registrando as atividades de manutenção, peças substituídas e recomendações para futuras intervenções. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no trabalho, utilizando os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e adotando práticas seguras durante a execução das tarefas. Prestar suporte técnico aos clientes, orientando sobre o uso correto dos equipamentos e explicando as intervenções realizadas. Requisitos:Ensino médio completo. Curso técnico ou profissionalizante em Refrigeração e Climatização. Experiência comprovada na instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado. Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos e mecânicos de refrigeração. Habilidade para realizar diagnósticos de falhas e executar reparos em componentes complexos. Carteira de habilitação (Categoria B) pode ser exigida para deslocamento até os locais de serviço.

description:
O Meio Oficial de Manutenção Elétrica é responsável por auxiliar na execução de tarefas de instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas elétricos, garantindo o funcionamento seguro e eficiente das instalações elétricas. Este profissional atua em apoio aos eletricistas e engenheiros, realizando atividades básicas de manutenção e reparo em conformidade com as normas técnicas e de segurança. Principais Responsabilidades:Auxiliar na instalação de sistemas elétricos, como fiação, painéis elétricos, interruptores, tomadas e outros componentes elétricos conforme as especificações do projeto. Realizar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, incluindo a inspeção de circuitos, componentes e equipamentos para identificar falhas e necessidades de reparo. Manter o ambiente de trabalho organizado e seguro, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados e seguindo as normas de segurança estabelecidas. Colaborar com a equipe de manutenção, seguindo instruções e orientações dos eletricistas e engenheiros para a execução eficiente das tarefas. Auxiliar na realização de testes e medições elétricas, utilizando instrumentos apropriados para verificar a eficiência e segurança dos sistemas elétricos. Participar do inventário e controle de materiais e ferramentas elétricas, garantindo o armazenamento e uso adequado dos mesmos. Relatar qualquer problema ou situação anômala observada durante as atividades aos profissionais responsáveis para a tomada de medidas corretivas. Requisitos:Ensino fundamental completo. Habilidade para utilizar ferramentas e instrumentos de medição elétrica de forma segura e eficiente. Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis às instalações e manutenções elétricas.

title: Associate, Client Success Operations
description:
Searching for:

Associate, Client Success Operations

About Us

GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil

GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.

Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise, and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.

Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.

GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

The Role:

The Client Success Operations Team is responsible for the diligent management of the assigned Buyers including country specifics, client servicing, service delivery, exceptions processing, program monitoring and risks reporting.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Support clients across Americas geography.
  • Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with numerous customer contacts at various levels of the organization and serves as a focal point for customer inquiries, requests, and complaints.
  • Provide information by collecting, analyzing and summarizing data, and responding to requests.
  • Ensure accuracy and efficiency of operations including collection and monitoring of receivables.
  • Prepare materials for use in status account reviews conducted at multiple corporate levels.
  • Responsible for territory risk management and customer satisfaction attainment.
  • Ensure all customer communications are documented in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Ensure accounts operate within approved guidelines and obtain the appropriate level of management approval in exception situations.
  • Keep customers appraised of the financial health of their account and its ability to support current and future financing volumes.
  • Proactive account management with effective communication skills.
  • Operate pro-actively at all times.
  • Timely reporting/escalating of risks, exceptions, incidents to Upline Managers.
  • Ensure agreements and all programs relevant procedures are updated regularly and safely stored on its respective file cabinets.
  • Share knowledge, initiatives and find better ideas to improve external and internal client satisfaction.
  • Support additional ad-hoc projects.
  • Adhere to company & operations policies.
  • Contribute to maintaining a positive, transparent, open and creative thinking working environment.
  • From time to time, willing to take over tasks/projects which are not related directly to this function.
  • Multicultural sensitivity/awareness.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Experience in handling complex and sensitive accounts.
  • Excellent analytical & problem-solving skills.
  • Thrives in a multi-task environment where there are competing priorities and deadlines/deliverables.
  • Ability to remain poised and calm under pressure.
  • Structured, fact-based way of work.
  • Prioritization
  • Pro-activity.
  • Time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to adapt to frequent changes effectively.
  • Take ownership and accountability of work assigned.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office especially Excel.
  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Team player – energetic, enthusiastic, and personable.
  • Ability to perform duties with the highest level of confidentiality and integrity.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin or any other category protected by law.

description:
Atendente de Farmácia - Jardim Guanabara

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.

description:
Horário: De segunda à sexta, 09h00 as 13h00 ou 14h00 as 18h00
Modalidade: Presencial
Descrição:

Descrição e Responsabilidades

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações.

Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos.

CONTEXTO DA VAGA:

A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa.

COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL:

Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras.

Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana , abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo.

É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa.

Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você!

COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

  • Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo) , apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF;
  • Preservar a imagem de MSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação;
  • Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores.

Requisitos:

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

• Português fluente;

• Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação;

• Pacote Office básico.

O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

• Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor.

QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

  • Gerenciamento de estresse pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma;
  • Capacidade de negociação para comunicar aos outros os seus próprios objetivos e demandas;
  • Iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades e problemas;
  • Flexibilidade comportamental para adaptar comportamentos as necessidades da situação.

Venha fazer parte da Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!

PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 31/07/2025

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno.
